artifactRefs.description: Telegram streaming config/runtime test and review evidence

contractCoverage.obligation: Global Telegram streaming setting enables live Telegram turn_stream frames without env opt-in.
Env 1 enables streaming; 0/off/false with whitespace disables it per process.
Redaction suppresses live and finalized turn_stream content.
Telegram live partial streaming must not make Discord or Slack post phase=live partials.

surfaceEvidence.invocation: bun --cwd=packages/coding-agent run check; bun run check:schemas

adversarialCases.scenario: Streaming env unset but global Telegram streaming setting true.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: A live turn_stream frame is emitted with messageRef matching the finalized frame.

adversarialCases.scenario: Global setting true but env is 0/off/false or whitespace-padded OFF.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: No live frames are emitted and finalized turn_stream has no messageRef.

adversarialCases.scenario: Streaming enabled while notification redaction is true.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: No live or finalized turn_stream content frames are emitted.

adversarialCases.scenario: Shared SDK emits phase=live turn_stream frames while Discord/Slack daemons are attached.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Discord and Slack ignore live partials; non-live/keyless turn_stream behavior remains available.
